summary: Phase 3 frontend-only verification of Pricing, Blog listing and Blog article for Tech Yugantar redesign. All three routes (/pricing, /blog, /blog/<slug>) return HTTP 200 with zero uncaught page errors and zero non-HMR console errors in both dark and light themes. Pricing: three engagement cards render, the middle one is visibly featured (aurora teal border, 'Most popular' pulsing badge, gradient teal 'Get a Custom Quote' CTA); every OfferList check icon renders as a teal check (computed color rgb(20,184,166) with bg-primary/15 chip) — the previously reported white-on-light invisibility is fixed and remains readable in light mode; all three cards' 'Get a Custom Quote' anchors point to /contact (6 matches across CTA + related links). Project Cost Estimator works end-to-end: Step 1 Next is disabled until a project type is selected; stepping through Platforms → Features → Scale & Design → Timeline all enable Next; 'See Estimate' renders a 'Your Project Estimate' panel with a starting price + typical range (₹30K, ₹30K–₹93K), a '2–5 weeks' timeline card and a 'Your selections' summary; INR/USD toggle switches the displayed currency (₹ → $ confirmed via body text) and 'Start Over' is clickable without error. Blog listing: pill filter row renders (All + django/next.js/flutter/react), 'All' pill is aurora-gradient active by default, clicking a tag pill filters posts (Django → 3 posts) and the clicked pill switches to the active gradient state, clicking 'All' restores 12 posts. Each post card shows image, teal category badge (top-right), title, excerpt, author + read time and links to /blog/<slug>. Article page (/blog/django-celery, /blog/nextjs-approuter): renders h1, meta (date + read time), aurora-gradient primary tag chip, hero image (Next/Image with fill+priority), MDX body with h2 headings + <pre> code blocks where source has fences, BlogCTA, tag list, LinkedIn/X share buttons, Related Posts and a 'Back to blog' link (a[href='/blog']). Reading-progress bar (data-testid=reading-progress) is fixed top:0, z-55, and its transform scaleX grows with scroll — measured matrix(0,…) at top → 0.79 mid-page → 0.99 at bottom. Theme toggle (aria-label='theme toggler') flips html between 'lenis dark' and 'lenis light' on all three surfaces with no invisible or washed-out text observed in either theme. Nav 'Pricing' and 'Blog' pills show the aurora active-pill styling on their respective routes.

issues: Tag hrefs are lowercase (/blog?tag=django, /blog?tag=next.js) even though the spec example uses '/blog?tag=Django'. Pill labels look correct because of CSS class 'capitalize', but a hand-typed URL with a capital letter (e.g. /blog?tag=Django) returns 0 filtered posts. Purely a spec/data-casing mismatch — functionally the in-app pill clicks work.

action_items: (Optional) If /blog?tag=Django (capitalised) needs to work per the spec example, either normalise the tag comparison to case-insensitive in src/app/blog/page.tsx or store tag frontmatter with the display casing (Django, Next.js, Flutter, React).

(Carry-over from iter_1/iter_2) Supervisor 'frontend' program still targets /app/frontend but the Next.js app lives at /app root — dev server is started manually via 'yarn dev'. Fix supervisor conf so the preview auto-recovers on pod restart.
critical_code_review_comments: src/components/Pricing/OfferList.tsx now correctly colours the check icon with 'text-primary' on a 'bg-primary/15' chip — teal check is visible in both themes.
src/components/Pricing/EngagementBox.tsx marks featured={i===1} with an aurora gradient CTA + 'Most popular' badge; hover motion via motion/react whileHover works and does not throw.
src/components/Blog/ReadingProgress.tsx uses useScroll + useSpring on scaleX with origin-left — the fixed 0.5px aurora bar is a11y-safe (aria-hidden) and behaves correctly.
src/app/blog/page.tsx uses <a> tags for tag pills which causes a full navigation on each click; consider next/link + prefetch for snappier UX (not a defect).
Article template renders MDXRemote with custom components; code blocks render as <pre>. Not all seed articles have code fences (nextjs-approuter.md has 0) — that's content, not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://yugantar-main.preview.emergentagent.com. Next.js app at /app root; dev server via 'cd /app && yarn dev'. Theme button aria-label='theme toggler', html toggles 'lenis dark' <-> 'lenis light'. Pricing calculator: Step 1 Next is disabled until a project-type card is clicked; buttons ₹ INR / $ USD toggle currency; Start Over returns to step 1. Reading progress bar selector: [data-testid="reading-progress"] — check getComputedStyle(...).transform matrix a-component to verify scaleX growth. Blog tag data is stored lowercase; hrefs are /blog?tag=<lowercase>.
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional defects reproduced in Phase 3.
